high_level_description: This image is a celebratory post from the Formula 1 official account (@F1) on social media, specifically Twitter. The post announces that Oscar Piastri has won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix (AzerbaijanGP). The text is enthusiastic and reads: "IT'S OSCAR PIASTRI AGAIN!!! 🏆 HE SOAKS UP THE PRESSURE AND TAKES VICTORY ON THE STREETS OF BAKU!! 👏👏" The hashtags used are The image features a cutout of Oscar Piastri
